Folks — forwarding Magnolia's redlines and an ask for exec/legal sign-off. Quick summary and my recommended play: 

Summary of change requests from Magnolia:
- Liability cap: asks to increase to $5M (currently $1M).
- Indemnity: expand to include third-party IP claims that arise in connection with customer data or outputs.
- Warranty: extend warranty/acceptance to 60 days.
- Commercial: 20% first-year discount if they commit 24 months.

Why I recommend we consider a limited concession: Magnolia is mid-market, good product fit, and wants to start in April. There's potential pipeline expansion across their clinical and lab informatics teams if we accept a slightly larger cap with mitigations. Suggested executive position: 
- Liability cap: increase to $3M (not $5M) if we get SOC2 Type II attestation and a 24-month term.
- Indemnity: allow a narrow carve-out for third-party IP where claim is directly traceable to their uploaded data or customised models they supplied; exclude claims arising from customer misuse.
- Warranty: accept 30-day acceptance window (compromise) with defined test cases in SOW.
- Discount: authorize up to 12% on ARR in exchange for 24-month commitment and prepayment of 6 months. Finance to confirm margins.

Attachments: redlines (see attached), pricing_summary.xlsx.

Can Laura/Aditya weigh in on exec/legal approval? If we can get a quick yes on the above compromises I will send a response to Tara and propose a revised SOW and commercial sheet.

Connor Obrien
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Team — reviewed Magnolia's redlines and Laura's proposed concessions. Legal is comfortable with the following concrete wording and constraints: 

1) Liability cap: Increase to $3,000,000 aggregate per 12-month period, expressly conditioned on (i) customer providing SOC 2 Type II attestation dated within the last 12 months and (ii) a 24-month minimum term in the MSA. Include explicit carve-outs: no cap for claims arising from gross negligence or willful misconduct.

2) Indemnity: Revised clause to cover third-party IP claims only to the extent such claims arise directly from customer-provided data, models, or instructions; exclude claims resulting from customer's modification of outputs or misuse. Add a requirement that customer promptly notify us and allow Redwood to control defense and settlement.

3) Warranty: Limit express warranty to 30 days post-delivery/acceptance; add an optional extended warranty and higher SLA as a billable add-on. Define acceptance criteria in SOW appendix A.

4) Discount & Commercials: Legal does not sign commercial discounts, but we will accept the commercial team position: up to 12% discount if finance confirms margin and customer prepays 6 months. If finance cannot support 12%, default to 10% per Laura's position. Include a one-time onboarding fee of $15k to cover professional services and rapid onboarding.

Please confirm below whether the sales team wants us to redline the MSA/SOW with this language and proceed to send a redlined package to Magnolia. If approved, I'll prepare the exact redline language for counsel sign-off and our contract management system.

Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
